intro.h2: Bathrooms one family keeps hiring them for
paragraphs: Trophy Tile and Bathroom Renovations does bathroom remodeling in Dawsonville, GA and throughout North Georgia. It is family-owned and run by Mendy and Joey, and its work centers on tile: walk-in showers, tub surrounds, floors and kitchen backsplashes. The Facebook page lists 15 years of experience.

The strongest proof is repeat business. One customer has had Trophy Tile remodel three of her bathrooms and is saving up for a fourth, and her daughter hired them for two more. Reviewers describe old tile torn out and redone, a crew that cleans up every afternoon, and showers that turned out better than they imagined.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Dawsonville, GA and beyond the bath

items.name: Custom tile showers
items.blurb: Old tile torn out and replaced with a walk-in shower built for how you live: subway or zellige-look walls, a recessed niche, hexagon mosaic floors and grab bars where you need them. 'Beautiful shower' is the phrase Google reviewers use most.

image.alt: Walk-in shower in white subway tile with a recessed niche, hexagon mosaic floor, black fixtures and grab bars

items.name: Full bathroom remodels
items.blurb: From a dated fiberglass tub and pedestal sink to a finished bathroom with a tile shower, new vanity, lighting and floor. One family has used Trophy Tile on three of their bathrooms, and their daughter on two of hers.

image.alt: Remodeled small bathroom with wood vanity, round black mirror, black light fixture and wood-look tile floor

items.name: Tub surrounds
items.blurb: Keep the tub and update everything around it. Recent work includes a cream handmade-look tile surround with a centered niche and matte black fixtures, a softer and warmer look than plain white. It is a good option when the tub is sound but the walls are dated.

image.alt: Tub surround in cream handmade-look tile with a centered niche and matte black shower fixtures

items.name: Kitchen backsplashes
items.blurb: A new backsplash changes a whole kitchen. In October 2026 Trophy Tile replaced a stone backsplash with glossy white subway tile that brightened the room and complemented the existing wood cabinets. Message them to talk backsplash ideas.

image.alt: Glossy white subway tile backsplash between cherry kitchen cabinets and a black granite countertop with gas cooktop

items.name: Tile flooring
items.blurb: Large-format plank and stone-look tile floors for bathrooms and the rooms around them, laid in a neat offset pattern with straight, even joints. Flooring and demolition of the old floor are both part of the remodeling work listed on their Facebook page.

image.alt: Bathroom floor in light grey plank tile laid in an offset pattern beside a white vanity

about.h2: Mendy, Joey and a family-owned crew
about.text: Trophy Tile and Bathroom Renovations is a family-owned and operated company based in Dawsonville, servicing North Georgia, with 15 years of experience listed on its Facebook page. Mendy and Joey are the names to ask for when you call. The company focuses on custom tile work and bathroom renovations, and says its favorite part of the job is meeting with clients. Its motto on Facebook is simple: team work makes the dream work. Customers describe a crew that is reliable, communicates well and treats your home with care.

steps.title: Schedule your estimate
steps.text: Call (678) 923-9568 or message Mendy and Joey to set up an estimate and talk through ideas for your bathroom or backsplash.

steps.title: Plan the tile
steps.text: Choose the tile, layout, niche and fixtures together. The team enjoys meeting with clients to shape the design.

steps.title: Tear out and build
steps.text: Old tile and fixtures come out and the new shower, tub surround or floor goes in, with clean up every afternoon.

steps.title: Final look
steps.text: Walk through the finished room together. Reviewers say the crew communicates well and is on time from start to finish.

service_area.text: Trophy Tile and Bathroom Renovations is based in Dawsonville and says it works throughout North Georgia, the words printed right on its logo. Most projects are bathrooms, showers and kitchen backsplashes in homes across the region. To check whether your town is on the schedule, call (678) 923-9568 Monday to Friday between 9 AM and 5 PM, or message the team on Facebook.

items.q: How do I get an estimate?
items.a: Call (678) 923-9568 or message Mendy and Joey on Facebook to schedule your estimate. You can also email trophytile75@yahoo.com with a few photos of your bathroom or kitchen so they can see what you are working with before the visit.

items.q: Can you tear out an old shower and redo it?
items.a: Yes. Several reviews describe exactly that: old tile torn out and the shower rebuilt. One customer says the crew was reliable, communicated well, cleaned every afternoon and did a phenomenal job. Their photos also show an old fiberglass tub replaced by a tiled walk-in shower.

Yes. Trophy Tile installs kitchen backsplashes as well as bathrooms. In October 2026 it replaced a stone backsplash with glossy white subway tile that brightened the kitchen and suited the existing wood cabinets. Message them on Facebook to chat about backsplash ideas for your kitchen.

Trophy Tile is based in Dawsonville and services North Georgia, as its logo says. If you are not sure whether your home is in range, call (678) 923-9568 and ask. Office hours are Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.

items.q: Who will I be working with?
items.a: Trophy Tile is family-owned and operated. Mendy and Joey run the business and are the people to contact for your estimate. They reply to their Google reviews personally, and repeat customers say they are fairly priced, on time, honest and clean.
